Figure 3. Comparison of the overall classification performance (intra-dataset and cross-dataset transfer measured in ACERall (%), Equation (2)) vs. GFLOPs per model. InternViT-6B has the second largest number of parameters and highest GFLOPs, while also achieving the best overall detection performance. Note that InternViT-6B processes images at approximately twice the resolution (see table 1), which is typically associated with a higher number of GFLOPs [43]. Although CLIP-B/32 has fewer GFLOPs than DeepPixBiS, its model size is much larger. CLIP-B/32 is also outperforming FSFM-FAS (backbone: CLIP-B/16), the specialized foundation model, on detection accuracy. Points are colored by model family. Lower ACER is better.
